comment: Advisory rollout for issue #4228 (2026). Collection is not evidence that executing bodies is free of external effects. Only the synthetic CI harness has been evaluated for this rollout.
not_evaluated_reason: Body effects have not been reviewed; network, scheduler and external-tool families remain collection-only.
timeout_basis: The collection timeout is a required command input, not an inferred acceptance limit. Workflow budgets follow the existing baseline-check.yml job budgets.
